comment: S_unexplored is a colon. The opening story is a corner text window; tty_dismiss_nhwindow() repairs it with docorner(offx, maxrow + 1, 0), whose row_refresh() skips GLYPH_UNEXPLORED cells, so the rows the story covered keep cl_end()'s blanks from column offx - 1 while rows below it keep their colons. A corner inventory menu then blanks a second rectangle.
